entries.name: unstage
entries.description: Take files out of the staging area without losing changes.

entries.name: undo
entries.description: Undo your last commit but keep its changes staged.

entries.name: reword
entries.description: Rewrite the message of your last commit.

entries.name: revert-last
entries.description: Cancel your last commit with a new commit; safe after pushing.

entries.name: discard
entries.description: Throw away unstaged changes in the files you name. Asks before running.

entries.name: wipe
entries.description: Return every tracked file to the last commit. Asks before running.

entries.name: cleanup
entries.description: Delete untracked files and folders. Asks before running.
